topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 36 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 18 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 20 common project-authored base contract(s) (ctokeninterface, ctokenstorage, cerc20interface). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
